compute_perplexity: compute perplexity scores for a list of input text strings using a causal language model
evaluate_language_model: evaluate a causal language model's perplexity on a list of prediction texts
calculate_mean_perplexity: calculate mean perplexity across multiple input text snippets with a specified model
run_batch_perplexity: run batched perplexity computation on text predictions with configurable batch size
test_perplexity_metric: test the Perplexity metric compute method with model_id and predictions arguments
